note: Distilled from microverse.json (final state) and microverse-runner.log (raw judge output). The judge ran once (iteration 2); iterations 3-6 were no-commit stalls, and the stall fired at iteration 6.

violation_ledger.description: runMuxRunnerMain is ~2202 lines — the entire iteration loop in one function, violating the 50-line hard limit and causing unclear ownership
buildCitadelAuditReport is ~122 lines — orchestrates 20+ analyzers inline, well over the 50-line hard limit
3232-line catch-all module bundles unrelated concerns: terminal formatting, ticket management, tier classification, settings loading, and environment utilities — violates SRP
checkPartialLifecycleExit is ~68 lines — reads files, parses tier, checks artifacts, classifies logs, and writes activity entries, over the 50-line hard limit
reapOrphanedManagersAtIterationStart is ~64 lines — collects ps suspects, reads pidfile, kills and records, over the 50-line hard limit
bootstrapSessionResources is ~61 lines — initialises monitor window, version drift, phantom-Done watchers, codegraph session, and signal handlers inline
